Dear Ms. Quinn,

Re: Account ID: ACC-981334

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account with Lakeshore Utilities. You have disputed the debt as already paid. We understand that you have been receiving daily calls from our agency regarding this account.

We have reviewed the account information, and the current balance is $342.31. The account was charged off on 2023-03-01. We do not have any record of a last payment date.

As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to cease collection activities if a consumer disputes the debt. However, we must also investigate the dispute and verify the accuracy of the account information. We will conduct an investigation into your dispute and will provide a response once completed.

Please note that you have the right to dispute the debt further if you believe the investigation does not accurately reflect the account status. You may also request validation of the debt, which we have previously indicated is not required in this case.

We will temporarily cease collection activities on this account while we conduct the investigation. We will contact you once the investigation is complete to provide an update on the account status.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
